verdict.rationale: Sprinto documents a 'custom-integration-push-apis' API reference (e.g. Integration Monitoring, Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs) and webhooks for external systems to push data in, which supports building integrations for uncovered systems, but there's no evidence of a full public API spec (openapi probe returned 404s), no code samples/SDKs, and no independent developer confirmation of building a custom integration. missing for 10: publicly discoverable OpenAPI/spec, concrete push-evidence code examples or SDK, independent developer validation that custom integrations work end-to-end.
